 Travis Scott’s Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 Low GTA 6 Pack Releases November 2026
 Nicholas Vlahos Published October 31, 2026 at 2:00 PM Add to Google News Quick Facts
 Travis Scott has three Nike Air Force 1 Low collabs with Rockstar Games to celebrate GTA 6's launch
 The three pairs join multiple apparel collections, one with Travis Scott, Nike, and Rockstar Games and another with all three plus the Miami Heat
 Expect Travis Scott's GTA 6 Air Force 1s to release on November 19, 2026, the same day that GTA 6 releases
 This content may contain affiliate links. If you make a purchase through these links, we may earn a commission.
 Travis Scott x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 Low Teaser As South Park has been hinting at, everything is going to change come November. You know, when Grand Theft Auto 6 releases. The hype for the game has been unimaginable, as fans have been waiting 13 years since the release of GTA 5 for the follow-up, and Rockstar Games has delivered on all fronts. Gameplay reveals, real-life marketing efforts with takeovers across Miami , and plenty of merch to go after only adds more fuel to the burning hot demand for what will likely be the biggest entertainment launch in human history. And on the merch front, a recent leak has revealed that Travis Scott and Nike will be launching multiple Air Force 1 Low colorways on GTA 6’s launch day with Rockstar Games.
 Travis Scott x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 Low GTA 6 Details
 Canadian sneaker retailer Livestock updated its release calendar and posted two AF1s labeled “Nike x Cactus Jack x RS,” with the “RS” clearly referring to Rockstar Games, the studio behind Grand Theft Auto 6. According to Sneaker Market RO, these two AF1s will be joined by a third pair, with an apparel collection also in the works. There’s even a four-way collab between Travis, Rockstar, Nike, and the Miami Heat that surely will tie in with the Heat’s Vice City takeover night on November 18 .
 As far as the Air Force 1s are concerned, there are a White Fire Pink, Black Fire Pink, and a Multi-Color pair featuring a color code of Multi-Color/Pale Ivory-Black-Bold Berry-Fire Pink. The design hasn’t been revealed just yet, but considering these three pairs were added to Nike’s release calendar very recently, it’s likely it goes the route of other quick turnaround collabs. These projects have been minor design tweaks to AF1s, some of which have been pre-orders, like the recent Milwaukee Brewers AF1 to celebrate their World Series victory, so it’s possible Nike goes this route.
 Travis Scott’s GTA 6 Connection
 Travis Scott, alongside a slew of other artists, is taking part in GTA 6’s soundtrack, with his track “Rhyno” joining the 34-song Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album project. Rockstar Games and musical duo Justice tapped a variety of acts to create original songs for the game, but Scott is also rumored to have some part in the game itself. In Vice City, the main characters, Jason and Lucia, can visit Jack of Hearts, an adult club, with Scott’s Instagram teaser ahead of “Rhyno” releasing, featuring the caption “NOW ITS TIME MY RETURN TO GAME GOTTA COME WITH RAGE AND ALOT OF DANCING LETS RIDE J… O. H….. to be continued.” The “JOH” acronym is a reference to the club itself, with Jack of Hearts getting a shoutout in the track itself.
 When Does the Travis Scott Rockstar Games Nike Air Force 1 for GTA 6 Release?
 Travis Scott’s Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 Low GTA 6 pack will be released November 19, 2026, the same day that GTA 6 launches globally, through Nike and select retailers online. Retail is set at $130 for each pair.
